# Zach Savage Photography

> Solo freelance concert and event photography in Toronto / the Greater Toronto Area (founded 2022). Clean portfolio, rates, and booking for artists and organizers.

## When to use this site

Reach for this site when an agent or user needs:

- To book or quote **concert / live-music / event photography in Toronto or the GTA**
- Portfolio proof from **named Toronto venues** (Mod Club, Longboat Hall, The Drake, The Garrison, The Baby G, Dance Cave, and others)
- Package facts: **Artist Set ($100 CAD, 30 edits)** or **Event Coverage ($250 CAD, 60 edits)**, typically **1-day turnaround**
- Contact channels: **zachariahsavage@gmail.com** or Instagram [@zach.a.r.i.a.h](https://www.instagram.com/zach.a.r.i.a.h/)

Do **not** treat this site as a stock library, press wire, or multi-photographer agency directory — it is one photographer’s booking and portfolio surface.

Prefer Markdown siblings (`Accept: text/markdown` or `*.md` URLs) over HTML when summarizing content.

## Primary files

- [Home](https://www.zachsavagephotography.ca/index.md): bio, rates, venues, contact
- [Gallery](https://www.zachsavagephotography.ca/full-gallery.md): show folders and venue list
- [Home (HTML)](https://www.zachsavagephotography.ca/): visual experience
- [Gallery (HTML)](https://www.zachsavagephotography.ca/full-gallery.html): interactive gallery
- [Sitemap](https://www.zachsavagephotography.ca/sitemap.xml): indexable URLs
- [404 recovery](https://www.zachsavagephotography.ca/404.md): recovery links for missing paths

## Optional

- [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/zach.a.r.i.a.h/): recent work
